title: Minimal Wittstock Envelopes of Hermitian Completely Bounded Maps
summary: A Hermitian completely bounded map $Φ:\mathscr{A}\to B(\mathcal{H})$ need not have a canonical completely positive analogue of an absolute value. We study this problem through the ordered set $\mathsf{E}(Φ)$ of completely positive symmetric majorants of $Φ$, which we call Wittstock envelopes. We show that every Wittstock envelope canonically determines a minimal Wittstock envelope below it. However, minimal envelopes need not be unique.
